game.title: Vanquish
game.blurb: Third-person shooter from Platinum Games (RAWG also lists GreenOrb), published by SEGA and GreenOrb, released 2010-10-19. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, Indie. Chapters follow the five Acts the Steam achievements name, plus Hard difficulty, challenges and combat feats.

chapters.title: DARPA Training, Acts 1 and 2
chapters.summary: The DARPA training exercises, then Acts 1 and 2, including the enemy transport in Act 2-2 and the Argus robots in Act 2-3.

chapters.title: Act 3
chapters.summary: Act 3, with its statue defence, cannons, monorail, floating turrets, armour escort and transport goals. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Acts 4 and 5 and the Finish
chapters.summary: Acts 4 and 5, the elevator stand in Act 4-1, the Buzzard in Act 5-1, and finishing every Act. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hard Difficulty and No-Death Run
chapters.summary: Each Act and the whole game on Hard or above, and finishing the game without dying.

chapters.title: Weapons, Challenges and Secrets
chapters.summary: Scanning every weapon, maxing one out, the Tactical Challenges, the hidden Pangloss statues and the cigarette tricks.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: AR Mode, melee, boosting, shooting down missiles, grenades, EMP, the LFE gun, rockets, the Lock-on Laser, Romanovs, Argus and reviving troops.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4206). RAWG's Steam store link points to app 460810 ("Vanquish"), which is used; its schema is named "Pineapple" (an internal codename). The store list also has a separate app 2076820 ("VANQUISH") that RAWG does not link; it was not checked or used. None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden. RAWG's detail says 448 achievements, far more than Steam's 50. The Acts are only numbered in the data, so the chapter titles use numbers; the achievement names (such as "Space Normandy" for Act 1) were not treated as Act names. "Defend the Pangloss statue in Act 3-2" sits in Act 3, while finding all the hidden Pangloss statues sits with the secrets. RAWG keeps "Bayonetta & Vanquish 10th Anniversary Bundle" (2020-02-18) as an addition. StrategyWiki has "Vanquish" as a stub (completion stage 0, Category:Stubs); only its Table of Contents (about 350 characters) is written, and Gameplay, Controls, Walkthrough and Achievements and trophies are linked but not written. vanquish.fandom.com answers the API under "Vanquish", but with only 14 linked articles, mostly general links (magazines, genres, Platinum Games, Sega); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
